highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple unversioned app TFM support and fixes a WinUI projection DLL failure.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: The v4 support for building against the Apple 26.0 SDK with unversioned app target framework monikers has been backported to the 3.119.x line.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 consumers fixed
bullets.detail: Apps targeting .NET 9 with WinUI no longer fail to locate the Projection DLL at runtime.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support to 3.119.5
